projects.name: dsh-dock
projects.description: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness feature dock plugin: a single panel uniformly registers and toggles all small features, including usage accounting (custom unit prices and time-of-use pricing), model settings and balance, 19 task animations, task notifications (DingTalk/Feishu), running status, an image understanding proxy, account-password remote access, and 10 mini games. Each feature is an independent module that can be toggled, has error isolation, and is plug-and-play.
projects.originalDescription: dsh-dock · DeepSeek Harness 功能坞插件：一张面板统一注册/开关所有小功能——用量记账（自定义单价·分时价）、模型设置与余额、19 种任务动画、任务通知（钉钉/飞书）、运行状态、图片理解代理、账号密码远程访问、10 款小游戏。每个功能独立模块，可开关、错误隔离、即插即用。
